hardware.binding_gpu: AMD Radeon Pro W7900, GPU0, gfx1100
hardware.component_gpu: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, GPU1, gfx1100

software.measurement_tree_note: B5 support and row-6 template instantiations were isolated uncommitted candidate changes over the recorded base. Final production source, tests, and suite were restored byte-identical to the base before publication.

audit_finding.reason_for_screen: The prior campaign closure had not measured the only supported higher shared-ABI/provider budget. B5 is algorithmically distinct because six target rows can reduce verifier pass count when acceptance is high.

admission_policy.correctness: All candidate-visible IDs and every GPU accept decision must match the exact own-AR/CPU oracle.
admission_policy.suite: Promotion requires non-regressive absolute throughput on the full ten-prompt suite, train, heldout, and every category; a favorable single prompt is insufficient.
admission_policy.rule: Do not spend a second full-suite run unless optimized B5 clears the predeclared per-pass ceiling on the same-process one-prompt screen.

unoptimized_full_suite.workload: mtpbench-code-general-ja, all 10 prompts, natural25, one run, same-process B3/B5, W7900
unoptimized_full_suite.interpretation: B5 increases accepted drafts and reduces verifier cycles, but missing row-6 optimized owners dominate its target wall. This fallback result alone does not adjudicate B5 economics.

unoptimized_profile.decision: Admit one RED-first row-6 extension of existing exact Q4/Q5/Q6 rowtile templates before final adjudication.

row6_candidate_validation.routing: Only rows=6 was added to the existing exact gfx1100 Q4 pack8 single/dual, Q5T16 col4, and planar-Q6 BF16/F32 template families. Row 5 stayed unsupported/unoptimized.

gpu1.outputs: row-6 single/dual BF16 and FP32 surfaces byte-exact; Q4/Q5 CPU KL/top-1 gates passed

optimized_one_prompt_screen.workload: code_merge_intervals, natural25, one warmup, same-process B3/B5, W7900
optimized_one_prompt_screen.admission_result: failed: 61.335 ms/pass exceeds the 50.3 ms full-suite break-even ceiling despite the favorable code prompt

optimized_profile.add_rmsnorm_note: B5 replaces 63 fused rounded-add+RMSNorm nodes (0.905 ms) with separate add/RMSNorm work totaling about 0.868 ms; this cannot recover the approximately 11 ms/pass still required.
optimized_profile.profiler_gap_note: Four recurring 5.728-5.799 ms intervals every 256 dispatches are the separately adjudicated rocprof instrumentation artifact and are excluded from any saving model.
optimized_profile.interpretation: The remaining B5 cost is the real arithmetic/resource cost of six exact rows, not a missing kernel family or launch rearrangement.

decision.reason: The frozen preliminary gate failed after all direct row-6 fallbacks were removed. Promoting from one favorable code prompt would violate the campaign anti-gaming and full-suite admission policy.
decision.reopen_condition: A materially different speculative algorithm, proposer-quality change, or hardware primitive that lowers six-row target cost below the frozen break-even; not another rearrangement of the closed exact rowtile families.
